Jalape\u00f1o.source_notes: BF16 1.7 PF/s assumed as half FP8. Fabric 600 GB/s treated as one-way; directionality uncertain. Memory input is 216 GiB, not 216 decimal GB.

TPU7x Ironwood \u00b7 FP8.name: Google TPU v7 Ironwood

TPU7x Ironwood \u00b7 FP8.source_notes: FP8 experts; no native FP4 rate assigned. Memory is 192 GiB. Aggregate six-link outbound ICI bound; two-chiplet memory domains, internal D2D, torus congestion and placement omitted.
